pageProps.title: Oedo Salt Grill
pageProps.review: A review of Oedo Salt Grill, a great value local restaurant in Oedo-dong, Jeju City, where you can enjoy well-aged black pork shoulder salt grill affordably and deliciously.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Black Pork Salt Grill", "rating": 4.5 } --- The shoulder meat is well-aged, cheap, and delicious. ``` ## Review I visited this restaurant without any expectations, and it's a hidden gem! The shoulder meat was well-aged, so I could eat it affordably and deliciously. ## Pictures
